title: Tomo Tag Handler Config
description: Schema for a single tag-handler config file (config/tag-handlers/<feature>.json). Defines matching rules, the action to perform, and how to compose the output. Spec: docs/XDD/specs/024-tag-handler-framework/

id.description: Unique handler identifier; also used as the routing-plan marker.

enabled.description: When false, the handler is skipped exactly like an invalid one.

capture_segments.description: Names for suffix path segments after the prefix.

read_fields.description: Frontmatter fields exposed to the compose step.

action.description: Action registry v1 value. The resolver (not this schema) rejects declared-but-deferred actions at runtime.

by.description: Which capture segment key is used to look up the map.

map.description: Mapping from capture segment value to target vault path.

marker.description: Anchor string in the target note (e.g. '## Captures'). Transformed to anchor.value by the resolver.

placement.description: Where to insert relative to the matched anchor.

oneOf.description: LLM directive: free-text instruction for how to synthesize the batch.
Mechanical template: ordered list of frontmatter field names to render.

compose.description: How to compose the handler output. Either a string (LLM directive) or an array of field names (mechanical template).

output_format.description: OPTIONAL — structure-aware rendering spec. Absent ⇒ today's prose-block behaviour. Spec: docs/XDD/specs/025-structure-aware-tag-handler-compose/ (FR-15, FR-18).

structure.description: Output block shape: table_row = one Markdown table row per item; list_item = one bullet per item.

order.description: Insertion order relative to existing rows/items under the anchor.

granularity.description: per_item = one row/bullet per inbox item; merged = LLM-merged single block.

cells.description: Ordered cell definitions. Each cell is either a direct field projection or an LLM synthesis directive (FR-18).

field.description: Frontmatter field name to project verbatim into this cell.

synthesize.description: LLM directive for synthesizing this cell's content from the batch.

join.description: Separator between cells for list_item structure. Ignored for table_row (cells map to columns). Default: ' — '.
